response.sql: WITH cust AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total FROM Customer c LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId), shares AS (SELECT CustomerId, total, total * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM cust) AS share FROM cust), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT s.total, s.share FROM shares s, avg_share v WHERE s.share > v.a) SELECT AVG(k.total) AS avg_spent, AVG(k.share) AS avg_share, AVG(k.share - v.a) AS avg_share_above_average FROM kept k, avg_share v;
